evidence.requirements: All brief items are met. The start page lists title, date/time, 'EUR n' price and '<n> seats left' with 'Book <title>' links (server.js:64-67, start.jpg). The form has labelled Name/Email/Guests fields (1–8) and a 'Book' button (server.js:71-76). Seat limit and invalid input are rejected with a message above the form (server.js:46-52, 70; form.jpg). The confirmation shows the 'Booking confirmed' heading, tasting, guests, total and reference (server.js:78-87, confirmation.jpg). /staff has a Password field and Sign in button, with the password taken from STAFF_PASSWORD (server.js:89-93, 176-177). Staff see bookings grouped by tasting with name/email/guests/ref and a Cancel button that frees seats (server.js:95-103, 155-159, staff.jpg). Uses PORT with default 3000, in-memory store, English UI. No unmet items found.
evidence.correctness: Validation and booking happen synchronously after the awaited body read (server.js:124-135), so concurrent requests cannot overbook in a single Node process. Seats are derived from current bookings (server.js:58), so cancelling (splice, server.js:157) frees seats correctly. Guests must match /^\d+$/ and fall in 1–8, which rejects 1.5, 0, 9 and empty input (server.js:49). Unknown tasting ids and refs return 404. Minor flaws: a name over 100 chars gets the misleading message 'Please enter your name.' (server.js:47). Booking refs are 4 random bytes with no collision check (server.js:129). The sold-out state still shows a working Book link and form, and only fails on submit (server.js:66).
evidence.security: All user data goes through esc() (server.js:10, 72-74, 101); the test confirms '<i>' is escaped. The password is compared with crypto.timingSafeEqual after a length check (server.js:40-44), and sign-in is disabled when STAFF_PASSWORD is unset (server.js:149). The session is a 32-byte random token in an HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict cookie (server.js:150-152), which also blocks CSRF on cancel. Cancel checks isStaff (server.js:157). Form bodies are capped at 10 kB (server.js:35). No secrets are in the code. Gaps: there is no logout, sessions never expire and the sessions Set grows on every login (server.js:56, 151). There is no login rate limiting and no Secure cookie flag.
evidence.code_quality: A single 180-line server.js with no dependencies. It has small, clearly named helpers (page, readForm, safeEqual, validate) and an injectable createServer(staffPassword) for tests (server.js:54, 180). Errors are handled centrally with a 413 path (server.js:164-171). Routing uses inline regexes with `m` assignment inside conditions (server.js:120, 140, 155), which works but is terse. The HTML templates are dense one-liners (server.js:66, 101) and hard to scan. The name-length error message is misleading.
evidence.tests: test/app.test.js runs the real HTTP server through node:test (no deps). It covers: booking and confirmation total (EUR 84) with the seat decrement; every validation branch, including the 0/9/1.5 boundaries; overbooking ('Only 3 seats are left'); sold out; staff page hidden without sign-in; a wrong password giving 401; HTML escaping; an unauthenticated cancel being ignored; and an authenticated cancel freeing seats (lines 14-80). Missing: no assertion on the start page's titles/prices/'Book <title>' links, no unknown-route/404 tests, no test with STAFF_PASSWORD unset, and no concurrency test.
evidence.ux_design: All screenshots show unstyled browser defaults: blue underlined links, tiny native inputs and buttons, and no branding beyond a text link (start.jpg, form.jpg). The error 'Please enter a valid email address.' is plain black text that looks like the surrounding paragraphs, with no colour, icon or field highlight (form.jpg). The confirmation is a default-indented <dl> (confirmation.jpg). The layout is clear and the information is complete, but it does not look like something a winery would put in front of guests. Dates are shown as raw ISO strings.
evidence.accessibility: Inputs are wrapped in <label> elements (server.js:72-74, 91). Errors use role="alert" (server.js:70, 89). The page has html lang="en", header/main landmarks and an h1/h2 hierarchy (server.js:13, 21-23, 97). Default black-on-white gives good contrast. Gaps: no aria-invalid or aria-describedby linking the error to its field, and focus is not moved to the error. The action columns have empty <th> cells (server.js:65, 100). Every staff 'Cancel' button has the same accessible name with no booking context (server.js:101). There are no autocomplete attributes on name/email.
evidence.simplicity: Zero runtime or dev dependencies; package.json has only start/test scripts. The whole app is one ~180-line file plus one ~80-line test file, which suits a three-tasting booking app.

strengths: Every brief requirement is met with exact labels and texts. Seat limits are enforced atomically and cancellations free seats (server.js:46-58, 124-135, 155-159).

Solid security for its size: consistent escaping, a timing-safe password check, random HttpOnly SameSite=Strict session tokens, cancel requires staff auth, and a body size cap (server.js:10, 35, 40-44, 150-152, 157).
Dependency-free, compact code with meaningful integration tests that cover validation boundaries, overbooking, sold out, escaping, auth and cancellation (test/app.test.js).
issues: The visual design is bare browser defaults with no winery branding. The form error is unstyled text that is barely distinguishable from other content (form.jpg, start.jpg, confirmation.jpg).
Session handling is minimal: no logout, no expiry, an unbounded in-memory sessions Set, and no rate limiting on staff sign-in (server.js:56, 147-153).

Accessibility and edge-case gaps: errors are not tied to fields (no aria-invalid/aria-describedby), staff Cancel buttons are indistinguishable to screen readers, sold-out tastings still offer a Book form, and over-long names get a misleading error (server.js:47, 66, 70-74, 101).
review.verdict: Functionally this is a correct, secure and well-tested app: it meets every requirement in the brief and holds the seat limit with no dependencies. Before guests use it, it needs basic visual design and clearer error styling, and staff sessions need a logout and an expiry.
